Law Article 3(1) says only a first-class electrician (第一種電気工事士) may work on 自家用電気工作物. It removes Paragraph 3 work (特殊電気工事) from that rule. This matches the explanation's claims that (1) is permitted and that (3) falls outside Paragraph 1.

Law Article 3(2) lets both first-class and second-class electricians (第一種・第二種電気工事士) work on 一般用電気工作物等, and sets no output limit. Law Article 3(3) and Enforcement Regulation Article 2-2(1)(ii) make work on the generator and related parts of an 非常用予備発電装置 a 特殊電気工事. That work requires a 特種電気工事資格者 certificate, and the regulation sets no output condition. A first-class license alone is not enough, so (3) is the incorrect statement. Enforcement Regulation Article 2-2(1)(i) makes ネオン工事 a special work only for 自家用電気工作物. A neon distribution board installed in a 一般用電気工作物 falls under Article 3(2), so a second-class electrician may do the work. The reasoning for (4) matches.
